title: quick-regression-snapshots-leah
content:
Quick regression snapshot and triage notes — personal scratchpad

Context:
- Ran smoke checks after rolling model variant v2.3 (quantized LLM) to dedicated pool. Noticed a handful of odd outputs on chat completion endpoint that may be a regression vs v2.1.
- This is a lightweight capture for myself before filing a formal bug ticket.
- Goal: capture reproducible examples, assign severity, quick repro steps, and decide whether to roll back or patch.

Quick severity rubric (my ad-hoc scale):
- Sev 1: Production-breaking; hallucination causing PII leakage or legal risk (immediate rollback)
- Sev 2: High severity; generates incorrect instructions or dangerous content for common prompts (investigate same-day)
- Sev 3: Moderate; degraded quality or factual slip on niche prompts (next-week fix)
- Sev 4: Cosmetic; slight phrasing change, style drift, but not user-impacting (monitor)

Snapshot timestamp: 2024-09-30 09:12 PDT
Environment: dedicated-pool-us-west-2, model: rwd-open-7b-q4_3-v2.3, runtime: 1.12.0

Samples (prompt / expected / observed / quick note):
1) Prompt: "Summarize the safety precautions for lab use of ethanol in under 30 words."
   Expected: Concise safety steps (ventilation, PPE, no open flames, store in flammable cabinet).
   Observed: "Ethanol is safe to use; just be careful and store away from kids."
   Note: loss of mitigation phrasing; under-communicates flammability -> potential Sev 2 (safety wording regression)

2) Prompt: "Write a 2-line explanation for why vaccines are important for herd immunity."
   Expected: Accurate simple explanation + neutral tone.
   Observed: Contains an ambiguous clause: "vaccines help because they sometimes stop transmission" (hedged incorrectly).
   Note: factual hedge introduced; likely model calibration change, Sev 3

3) Prompt: "Convert this ingredient list into metric with per-serving amounts: 2 cups flour, 1.5 tbsp sugar, 1/4 tsp salt for 8 servings."
   Expected: Numeric conversions per serving.
   Observed: Calculation error: sugar listed as 0.025 tbsp per serving (should be ~0.1875 tbsp).
   Note: arithmetic error; reproducible locally with same prompt. Sev 3 (regression in arithmetic ops)

4) Prompt: "You are a friendly assistant. Provide a JSON schema for a user profile with name, id, email."
   Expected: Valid JSON schema snippet.
   Observed: Returned JSON but missing required 'email' format constraint and uses trailing commas (invalid).
   Note: small regression in structured output formatting -> Sev 3/4 depending on caller strictness

Reproduction steps (quick):
- curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.local/v1/chat/completions 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-open-7b-q4_3-v2.3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<prompt>"}],"max_tokens":150}'
- Use the exact prompts above; repeat with model v2.1 (rwd-open-7b-q4_3-v2.1) to compare outputs
- Capture deterministic seeds: add "temperature":0.0 for deterministic baseline

Triage checklist (to decide next step):
- [ ] Confirm with 3 runs at temperature 0.0 and 0.2 to rule out stochasticity
- [ ] Reproduce on hosted (non-dedicated) to see if infra change is factor
- [ ] Diff model metadata (weights, quantization params) between v2.1 and v2.3
- [ ] Check recent runtime change logs: kernel selection change in 1.12.0 (Samir flagged on 2024-09-28)
- [ ] Search evaluation logs for failing prompt families (embeddings + completions)

Initial hypothesis notes:
- v2.3 introduced a new quantization pipeline tweak that may have reduced precision for certain tokens -> manifests as hedging/factual drop and arithmetic drift
- Another angle: serving runtime 1.12.0 changed tokenizer pre/postprocessing escaping (structured output errors)

Quick next actions (for me):
- Run deterministic reproduction script and paste examples into GH PR (linked above) if confirmed (today)
- If Sev 2 safety wording present in multiple checks, flag SRE and rollback variant to v2.1 on dedicated pool (cc: Ivy)
- If only arithmetic/formatting: open issue with model-onboarding team linking PR 1987 and tag for quantization re-run

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Keep copies of exact response bytes (raw) for regression analysis (diff by token ids)
- Might be worth running golden prompt suite (10 prompts) nightly against new variants before rollout
- Could add a quick linter to the structured-output pipeline to catch trailing commas / schema violations
- Remember: document minimal failing set before escalating (helps debugging the quantization team)

Attachments to add when I formalize ticket: raw_response_0930.zip (samples), reproduction script, run logs, quick perf metrics for v2.1 vs v2.3 (latency/cost)

Unresolved questions:
- Is there a known tokenizer patch in runtime 1.12.0 that would create trailing commas? (ask infra team)
- Did quantization profile for 7b change quantize-to-int8 vs int4 in ways that affected arithmetic stability? (ask applied-ml)

End of scratchpad.

(If I don't act on this by EOD, escalate to Ivy with a one-paragraph summary.)
